about: Every registry command and every capability of every panel, with the AI tool that covers it or an accepted gap. Gaps: not_built (names the milestone that builds it), needs_pointer (names the tool that takes points instead), writes_into_game (no tool ever covers it), user_only (only the user may do it). A row may add 'also': the generic tools that reach it meanwhile. tests/test_mcp_coverage.py keeps this file current. 'surfaces' has one row per menu entry, dialog class, Mesh Editor host command, Mesh Editor helper control and rail page found in the source, each with its tool, its registry command or a gap; generic_only is a gap the generic tools already reach and names the plan item that will type it.

browse.remove_old_install.reason: Deletes files in the game folder after the user reviews the list; only the user may confirm it.

browse.restore_backup.reason: Writes backed-up files back into the game folder; only the user may confirm it.

shell.import_profile.reason: A profile carries the AI connection settings and the game folder; only the user imports one.

command_patterns.note: One per rail entry (cdmw/ui/shell/shell_commands.py tool_commands); app.open_tool runs them by key.
Mirrored from the Mesh Editor helper's keymap at run time; mesh.command runs them by the helper's id. One whose id or label says build, export, delete or remove asks as output or destructive.
